head: The Birth Bag: labor support app for birth partners, made by a doula
dek: The Birth Bag is a new $4.99 iPhone app that guides birth partners, doulas and nurses through labor with position ideas and comfort steps. It was #31 among paid Health & Fitness apps on the US App Store on 18 November.
details: You enter details such as dilation, station and concerns like an epidural or back pain, and it suggests positions with steps and safety notes. It has 74 position guides in labor order, a contraction and time log, birth notes and scripts for partners. It works offline, needs no account and has no ads. The maker, Nurture and Connect Doula Services LLC, says it isn't medical advice.
means: If you'll support someone in labor, this puts practical steps on your phone, even without signal.
todo: Install it before the due date and look through the positions ahead of time; follow the care team's advice in the room.
thumb_words: LABOR HELP APP FOR BIRTH PARTNERS
